slides.texte_overlay:
5 posture mistakes that
make you look nervous
Mistake 1: hunching over your phone in public. Your shoulders curl and your head drops. Lift the phone to eye level or put it away, and you instantly look more at ease.
Mistake 2: clenching your jaw. Stress sits in your face, and people read it as tension. Let your jaw drop slightly and relax your forehead. You'll look calm.
Mistake 3: keeping your hands hidden. Hands deep in pockets or behind your back look like you're hiding something. Let them hang loosely or rest them on the table.
Mistake 4: tapping your foot. Under the table, at the bar, in meetings. It broadcasts impatience. Plant both feet flat on the floor and keep them still.
Before: tense in every crowded room. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and a calmer head that makes my body finally relax around people.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: tense in every crowded room. After: five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Now my body relaxes around people.

slides.texte_overlay: Mistake 5: touching your collar and tie. Constant adjusting looks insecure. Check yourself once in the mirror before you leave, then forget about your clothes.
The fix: three deep breaths before you walk in. Shoulders down, chin level, slow exhale. It takes ten seconds and changes how you carry yourself for the whole evening.
